name: Slack
difficultyLabel: Moderate — install is easy; Marketplace is not

timeEstimate.setupHours: 1–3 hours for app create + scopes + Composio wiring
timeEstimate.approvalWait: None for distributing your own install link; Marketplace preliminary up to ~10 business days + functional review up to ~10 weeks
timeEstimate.calendarTotal: Same day for private/your users; weeks–months if you need Slack Marketplace listing

summary: Creating a Slack app and completing OAuth for your customers can be done quickly. The hard path is Slack Marketplace approval: it requires real workspace installs before submission and has multi-week review. Most Composio agent builders only need installable OAuth — not Marketplace.
whenYouNeedThis: Consent screen should show your app name
You need specific bot/user scopes beyond managed defaults
You want Marketplace discovery (optional, slow path)
prerequisites: Slack workspace where you can create apps
Clear list of bot and user scopes your agent needs
Privacy policy URL if pursuing Marketplace
For Marketplace: installs on 5+ active workspaces before submission

steps.title: Create a Slack app
steps.detail: Go to api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From scratch. Pick a development workspace.

steps.title: Configure OAuth & Permissions
steps.detail: Add Redirect URL: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback. Select only the scopes you need.

steps.title: Install to a test workspace
steps.detail: Install the app, confirm OAuth works, and verify scopes. Broad history scopes invite scrutiny later if you pursue Marketplace.

steps.title: Copy Client ID and Client Secret
steps.detail: From Basic Information → App Credentials. Store the secret securely.

steps.title: Create Composio custom auth config
steps.detail: Slack → OAuth2 → your credentials. Pass auth config ID when initiating connections.

steps.title: Decide whether Marketplace is required
steps.detail: Skip Marketplace unless you need Slack’s directory. If you need it, gather 5 active workspace installs and prepare listing materials before submitting.

blockers: Marketplace submission blocked until 5+ active workspace installs (active = used in past 28 days)
Legacy or overly broad scopes (e.g. broad *:history without justification) can delay or block Marketplace review
Resubmitting during preliminary Marketplace review can restart the queue clock
nuances: Distributing via your own OAuth install link does not require Marketplace approval.
Slackbot vs Slack toolkit naming in Composio — pick the toolkit that matches bot vs user token needs.
Managed Slack OAuth exists in Composio; BYO mainly for branding, scopes, and quota.
agentCanDo: Separate “create Slack app” timeline from “Marketplace approval” timeline
Draft a minimal scope list from your agent’s intended actions
Provide redirect URI and Composio wiring steps
Summarize Marketplace prerequisites from public docs
humanMustDo: Create the Slack app and set redirect URLs
Complete OAuth installs in real workspaces
Submit Marketplace materials if you choose that path
nextAction: Create the Slack app and set Composio’s redirect URI today. Do not start Marketplace review unless directory listing is a hard launch requirement.

notes: Managed OAuth available for SLACK / SLACKBOT.
Custom auth config required for white-labeled consent.
